heading:
Letters of appreciation
from district leadership

items.quote: Appreciated and placed on record the excellent individual work done by Thiru. D. Ramprakash, Computer Informatics, Ramanathapuram, for accomplishing the gigantic election task enthusiastically day and night.
items.name: Thiru. K. Sellamuthu, IAS
items.designation: District Election Officer & District Collector, Ramanathapuram
items.date: 12 May 2006 · Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly Elections

items.quote: Conveyed sincere gratitude and thanks for all technical and institutional support provided during his tenure as District Collector — a demonstration of the firm's unwavering commitment to public service.
items.name: Dr. S. Vijayakumar, IAS

items.quote: Certified purchase of computer workstation and HP printer under government loan. The firm has rendered prompt, high-standard on-site maintenance service with proven hardware reliability.
items.name: K.P. Maghendhran, IPS
items.designation: Deputy Inspector General of Police, Ramanathapuram Range

items.quote: Certification of long-standing Annual Maintenance Contract excellence for central government scientific research infrastructure — a trusted partner to CMFRI's ongoing marine research mission since 2004.
